outcome: increased abdominal and thoracic circumference in infants
cohort: 164 pregnant women with a gestational age of 20 weeks or more at Lahore General Hospital, excluding those who were underweight, had previous anomaly babies or miscarriages.
finding: Obese pregnant women were more susceptible to developing gestational diabetes mellitus, pregnancy-related hypertensive disorders (including pre-eclampsia), and had infants with longer hospital stays and increased abdominal and thoracic circumference.
